TUR.scope: Turkey 1992 reform plan (player's 1992 table and tax screenshots), 1990 sheet mix for the tax split.

mechs.name: Income tax (wage withholding, cadastre-matched)
mechs.note: Phase III-IV 1992 table: industrial turnover, payroll and VAT gains $43.60B, split by the 1990 sheet mix (direct taxes 41.9%). PIT brackets 25-50% kept, cadastre matching applied.

mechs.name: Corporate tax (46% + 20% alternative minimum)
mechs.note: CIT 46% base with a 20% Alternative Minimum Tax (tax-changes screenshot).

mechs.name: Value-added tax (12% standard, 20% luxury, 4% reduced)
mechs.note: VAT raised from 10% to 12%, luxury 15% to 20%, reduced rates consolidated at 4%. Share 35.8% of tax per 1990 sheet.

mechs.name: Excise and other taxes on goods and services
mechs.note: Other taxes ($1.37B in 1990 sheet), scaled to 1992.

mechs.name: Foreign trade taxes (customs)
mechs.note: Customs and foreign trade, 15.6% of tax per 1990 sheet ($3.22B).

mechs.name: Non-tax revenue, EBF consolidation and concessions
mechs.note: Non-tax and extra-budgetary fund receipts (1990 sheet $4.43B) scaled into the 1992 total.

mechs.name: Idle land and mining tax and lease fees
mechs.note: 1992 table: 4-10% idle arable/mining tax and concession fees, $1.85B.
